europe_now.title: Polish Court Sentences Man Over Zelensky Assassination Plot
europe_now.summary: A Polish court has handed down a five-and-a-half-year prison sentence to a local man convicted of assisting in a Russian plot to assassinate Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky.

europe_now.title: French General Acknowledges Collapse of Joint Tank Program
europe_now.summary: A top French general has publicly confirmed that the joint main ground combat system tank development program between France and Germany has failed.

top_stories.title: Diplomatic Outreach for Ukraine
top_stories.summary: European officials and envoys designated by Trump are scheduled to meet in Miami to evaluate fresh proposals concerning peace in Ukraine. Discussions come as security concerns remain heightened across the continent regarding potential conflict spillovers.

top_stories.title: Social Unrest in France
top_stories.summary: Student and high school demonstrations continue to disrupt various parts of France with participants vowing to sustain their movement. Political parties are currently weighing their policy responses as the demonstrations show little sign of concluding.

europe_now.title: Polish Court Sentences Man in Russian Assassination Plot
europe_now.summary: A Polish court has sentenced a man to 5.5 years in prison for his involvement in assisting a Russian plot to assassinate Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky. The case highlights ongoing regional security threats and cross-border intelligence operations connected to the war in Ukraine.

europe_now.title: France-Germany Defense Programs Face Setbacks
europe_now.summary: A top French general has publicly acknowledged the failure of the joint Franco-German tank development program, signaling difficulties in major European defense collaboration. Meanwhile, separate discussions continue among European officials regarding broader regional security partnerships.

top_stories.title: Ukraine Peace Discussions and Diplomatic Outreach
top_stories.summary: European officials and U.S. envoys are convening in Miami to deliberate on fresh concepts for achieving peace in Ukraine. Concurrently, ongoing attacks on civilians and infrastructure continue to intensify humanitarian concerns across the region.

top_stories.title: Housing Protests and Social Unrest in Europe
top_stories.summary: Spain is observing widespread mourning and demonstrations following an eviction incident that triggered national protests over housing conditions. In France, student and high school demonstrations continue to persist as political groups debate their policy responses.

top_stories.title: European Union Testing of Chinese Artificial Intelligence
top_stories.summary: European Union cybersecurity and scientific researchers are actively testing artificial intelligence models developed in China. The assessment focuses on examining the Chinese software to better understand its technical capabilities and functions.

top_stories.title: European Strategy on Critical Raw Materials
top_stories.summary: The European Union is encountering difficulties in its strategic initiative to reduce dependence on Chinese critical raw materials. Efforts to curtail China's commanding market position in essential mineral supply chains continue to struggle.

top_stories.title: NATO Pre-Exercise Communications with Russia
top_stories.summary: NATO is working to reduce friction with Russia as the alliance prepares to launch a major nuclear exercise. The military alliance is seeking to mitigate potential misunderstandings surrounding the upcoming scheduled drills.
